topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe they used my essay like that. I poured my heart into writing it, just me and my thoughts, trying to show who I am, what mattered to me. I wrote it thinking maybe, just maybe, it would help me stand out, get noticed in all the noise. Now, it's out there, an example for anyone to see. It feels...exposed, like I didn't have a say in what happens to my words. I wish they had asked, or at least given me a heads up. It's hard to see it this way, detached, when it felt so personal and real when I was writing it.
